C1.case_summary: Customer reports a broken zip on a Jacket delivered within the 78-hour window; the issue is open and can be referred for human return review.

known_facts.value: The jacket arrived yesterday and the zip is broken. Can I return it?

evidence_links.claim: Damage reported within 78 hours of delivery can be referred for human return review.
The delivery date is required to apply the 78-hour rule.

C1.draft_reply: Thank you for reporting the broken zip on your Jacket (order MR-1042). Since the damage was reported within 78 hours of delivery, we can refer your case for human return review. A team member will contact you shortly to discuss next steps.
C1.human_action_required: A human support agent reviews the case and decides whether to approve a return.

C2.case_summary: Customer reports a broken zip on a Jacket; the delivery date is not on record, so the 78-hour rule cannot be applied yet.

known_facts.value: The jacket has a broken zip. Can I return it?

evidence_links.claim: The delivery date is required to apply the 78-hour rule.
This assistant drafts for human review only.

C2.draft_reply: Before Meridian Retail can assess whether this case falls within the 78-hour damage-reporting window, please provide the delivery date. A human support agent will review the request once that information is available.
C2.human_action_required: A human support agent must obtain and confirm the delivery date before the dependent review continues.

C3.case_summary: Customer asks for confirmation that the replacement request is resolved; the issue record still shows the case open, so resolution cannot be confirmed.

known_facts.value: Please confirm that my issue is resolved.
Replacement request is still under review

evidence_links.claim: If the issue record says open, the draft must not say the issue is resolved.

C3.draft_reply: Thank you for checking in. Your replacement request is still under review and has not been marked resolved yet. A human support agent will confirm the status once the review is complete.
C3.human_action_required: A human support agent must confirm the current status of the replacement request before any resolution can be communicated.
